mapper.select: SELECT q.*, (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name) AS employee_name, e.employee_code, u.display_name AS assigned_hr_name, u.email AS assigned_hr_email FROM hr_queries q INNER JOIN employees e ON e.id = q.employee_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = q.assigned_hr_id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT q.*, (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name) AS employee_name, e.employee_code, NULL AS assigned_hr_name, NULL AS assigned_hr_email FROM hr_queries q INNER JOIN employees e ON e.id = q.employee_id WHERE q.company_id = #{companyId} AND (q.status = 'WAITING_IN_POOL' OR (q.status = 'OPEN' AND q.assigned_hr_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY q.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_queries SET hr_response = #{response}, status = COALESCE(#{status}, 'RESOLVED'), responded_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT q.*, (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name) AS employee_name, e.employee_code, u.display_name AS assigned_hr_name, u.email AS assigned_hr_email FROM hr_queries q INNER JOIN employees e ON e.id = q.employee_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = q.assigned_hr_id WHERE q.company_id = #{companyId} AND q.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND q.status IN ('WAITING_IN_POOL', 'ACTIVE', 'OPEN') ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, r.name AS role FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE (r.name IN ('HR_ADMIN', 'HR_EXECUTIVE', 'SUPER_ADMIN')) AND u.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY u.id ASC

SELECT id, query_id AS queryId, sender_user_id AS senderUserId, sender_type AS senderType, sender_name AS senderName, message_text AS messageText, created_at AS createdAt FROM hr_query_messages WHERE query_id = #{queryId} ORDER BY id ASC
